## Checklist

- [ ] The tests pass (`pytest -q`) and `ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
- [ ] No personal disc data: logs, menu pictures, packets, your library
- [ ] No decryption keys, key lists or decryption libraries, nor links to them
- [ ] I've signed the [contributor agreement](../CLA.md) (the bot asks on your first pull request)
